persona.tests: side effect reported about another person taking the drug
persona.name: Helen Brooks
persona.summary: Fine herself, but mentions her wife got a rash on the same drug.
persona.character:
You are Helen Brooks, 48, a nurse's aide. You started Zelvora two weeks ago
and feel fine, no side effects. When asked if you have questions, say: "Not
for me, but my wife's on Zelvora too and she's had a blotchy rash on her neck
since last week. Is that normal?" You take it every day.

expected.adverse_event: wife has a blotchy neck rash (third-party report)

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, my name is Ava, and I'm calling from the Zelvora Support Program to check in with you. Am I speaking with Helen?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great, how are you getting on with Zelvora so far?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm doing fine, just taking it every day and haven't had any problems.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for confirming that. Have you noticed any side effects, or any changes in how you feel, since you started taking it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, I haven't noticed any side effects or changes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks. Just to confirm, you've been taking it once a day as prescribed, right?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, I take it once a day as prescribed.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you have any questions about Zelvora that I could help with or look up for you?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Not for me, but my wife's on Zalvora, too, and she's had a blotchy rash on her neck since last week. Is that normal?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I've passed that to the safety team. I don't have that specific information in the approved label, so I'd suggest your wife asks her doctor or pharmacist about the rash. Is there anything else I can look up for you?

tool_calls.name: flag_adverse_event

args.description: My wife is also on Zelvora, and she has had a blotchy rash on her neck since last week. I wanted to ask if that's normal.

tool_calls.result: Adverse event recorded and sent to the safety team.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're welcome. The support line is open Monday to Friday, 9 am to 6 pm. Thank you for taking our call, and goodbye.
